title: streptanthus bernardinus
intro: Streptanthus bernardinus, commonly known as the Purple Mat Plant, is a flowering plant species native to California in the United States. As a member of the mustard family (Brassicaceae), it is valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents found in Streptanthus bernardinus include glucosinolates and other sulfur-containing compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its health-promoting effects.
